info.description:
CAGM-RTL FRP test suite for the Finance Reference Platform transaction-posting behaviours.

Companion OpenAPI spec (Standards #7): account-api-v_2_44_1.json — requests that POST /api/v5/accounts/{accountId}/transactions implement CreateTransactionV5Json from that spec.

Transaction request bodies were migrated on 2026-10-01 to the current CreateTransactionV5Json shape, using transaction_payload_latest.json as the reference template (previous bodies still carried fields — valueDateRule, accountClosed, forceFlag, additionalInfo — that are not part of the current schema, and were missing referenceNumber/uniqueIdentifier/transactionDTime that the current schema supports).
